thread:
maria.g: Quick sync — follow-up from the 03/18 postmortem re: flood of paging alerts. Need owners & dates for the tuning work so we can close the action items. TL;DR: noise from high-cardinality errors + aggressive latency thresholds.

sam.k: I can own dedupe rule changes (query-level). Will do an initial PR with test alerts. Target EOD Thu? :thumbsup:

lucas.r: I can take thresholds/latency SLO alignment. Plan: run qps/latency histograms for last 30 days, propose new buckets. Need access to the eval dataset — @maria.g can you share the link?

maria.g: link: https://wiki.redwood.ai/postmortems/2026-03-18-noisy-pages (section 3 has signal files). Also added sample query set to the shared drive.

priya.v: For paging policy: propose moving some alerts to async page (pagerduty low-critical) + add suppression window for repeated similar errors within 10m. I can draft policy language and update the routing rules.

dennis.s: I'll handle the Alertmanager dedupe config (label set normalization). Quick note: we should avoid broad label dropping that masks real multi-tenant failures.

sam.k: On the PR flow: I'll open a small test PR that changes the dedupe fingerprint for the problematic rule:
```yaml
- alert: HighWorkerErrors
  expr: sum by (job,error_type) (increase(worker_errors_total[5m])) > 50
  # change fingerprint to ignore request_id
  labels:
    dedupe_fingerprint: "{{ job }}:{{ error_type }}"
```
That should collapse per-request noise.

lucas.r: For thresholds I ran the histogram and 95th is spiky due to backoff storms. Proposal: increase alert threshold from 200ms -> 400ms for non-prod-heavy routes and add a slow_request_rate alert that uses rate() over 10m. Will post numbers later today.

maria.g: Good. Can each owner drop a one-line acceptance criteria and deadline here? Want to close loop by next Tuesday.

sam.k: Acceptance: dedupe reduces paging volume for rule X by >=70% in staging for 48h. Deadline: 2026-03-31.

lucas.r: Acceptance: latency alert false positives <=5% on the evaluation set; dashboard shows reduced churn. Deadline: 2026-03-30.

priya.v: Acceptance: routing policy updated, doc + PD escalation mapping changed, and a 7-day pilot with oncall notified. Deadline: 2026-03-29.

dennis.s: Acceptance: Alertmanager rule normalized, no cross-tenant suppression; runbook updated. Deadline: 2026-03-28.

maria.g: Thanks. I'll create task cards in the postmortem (added) and link PRs here when ready. Also scheduling a 15m follow-up standup on Mon 10:00 to check progress.

lucas.r: One more ask — can we add a synthetic test that fires the alert in staging automatically? I can add a small load job to the infra repo.

sam.k: +1 — makes it easier to measure the 70% reduction.

priya.v: For the pilot, suggest we whitelist a single service owner for the first week so they can validate false positives. Also will add a rollback plan.

maria.g: Noted. Action items recap (added as bullets in the issue): 1) sam.k — dedupe PR + staging test (due 2026-03-31). 2) lucas.r — threshold proposal + synthetic test (due 2026-03-30). 3) priya.v — paging policy + pilot plan (due 2026-03-29). 4) dennis.s — Alertmanager normalization + runbook (due 2026-03-28). 5) maria.g — create issue, schedule follow-up, notify CS for impacted customers (done).

pagerduty-bot: Incident follow-up created: INC-2026-4455, notification sent to primary oncall.

dennis.s: I'll also add a monitoring query to track alert churn (# of alerts per hour per rule) so we can validate improvements after changes.

maria.g: Perfect. If anyone needs extra cycles ping me. We should avoid tuning-only escapes; want measurable SLO alignment.

sam.k: Will open PR and link here shortly.

lucas.r: Posting histograms & proposed thresholds in 30m.

priya.v: Drafting policy now, will tag owners in the doc.

maria.g: Closing thread — I'll post the follow-up issue link when all PRs are linked. Thanks all. :heart:
